<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13135> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The act of formally expressing an opinion or choice in some matter or for some candidate, usually by voice or  ballot."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13136> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The buildings, machinery, facilities, related to agricultural production."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13142> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Political course of action aiming at establishing trade agreements among the states."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13147> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "1) Title to or an interest in any property.\n2) Any interest or privilege recognized and protected by law."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13151> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The study, policies or system of institutions and procedures by which a country or region's commerce is supplied with notes, coins, bank deposits or other equivalent mediums of exchange."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13157> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A group or association of persons united to address the concerns, methods and professional status of instructors or educators."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13160> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The categorization of enterprises or organizations involved in an economy."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13164> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Cultivation of land for the production of plant crops. Agricultural land may be employed in an unimproved state with few, if any, management inputs (extensive rangeland), or in an intensively managed state with annual inputs of fertilizer, pest, control treatments, and tillage."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13170> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The geography of people making a living, dealing with the spatial patterns of production, distribution and consumption of goods and services. The development of economic geography over the past three decades has witnessed the substitution of analysis for description, leading to an identification of the factors and an understanding of the processes affecting the spatial differentiation of economic activities over the earth's surface."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13184> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The use of financial resources for the purpose of incorporating ecological principles in the operations of businesses and companies."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13186> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The accumulated volume or biomass remaining from gross production after accounting for losses due to respiration during production, herbivory, litterfall, and other factors that decrease the remaining available biomass."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13187> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The activity of finding solutions for troublesome or perplexing situations involving ecological or natural resources."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13189> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Plants employed in industry, e.g. cotton, flax, hemp, peanuts, etc."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13192> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Property of agricultural land and anything permanently affixed to the land, such as buildings, fences, etc."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13205> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Plants which store edible material in a root, corm or tuber; root crops used as food vegetables or fodder include carrots, parsnips, swedes and turnips; starchy root crops include potatoes, cassavas and yams."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13207> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any overall structure or set-up used to organize the activity of preparing land or soil for the growth of new crops, or the activity of promoting or improving the growth of existing crops."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13209> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The act or process of yielding produce from farmland, for livestock or human consumption."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1320> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The particular method of manufacturing or making a chemical usually involving a number of steps or operations."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13212> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Industry related with the technical and mechanical activity of removing coal from the earth and preparing it for market."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13213> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Industry which converts various types of fuels as well as solar, water, tidal, and geothermal energy into other energy forms for a variety of household, commercial, transportation, and industrial application."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13215> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A sector of the economy in which an aggregate of commercial enterprises is engaged in the design, manufacture and marketing of electronic machines designed to accept information or data that is easily manipulated for some result based on a program or some set of instructions, and the technology or materials used with these machines, such as storage devices, terminals and peripheral equipment."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13218> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Research and development, design, manufacture and measurement of high accuracy components and systems. It is related to mechanical, electronic, optical and production engineering, physics, chemistry, and computer and materials science."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13223> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Machines and tools employed in manual and mechanical labour."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13224> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Equipment operating with an internal pressure greater than atmospheric."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1322> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Properties of a substance depending on the arrangement of the atoms in the molecule, e.g. bio-availability, degradability, persistence, etc."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13232> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The aggregation of services, including construction, development, maintenance and leasing, performed for human-occupied properties, such as office buildings and apartment houses."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13237> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A schedule of revenues and expenditures for a specific time period that is devised by the European Community, a body of people organized into a political unity."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13238> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any form of financial assistance or inducement for persons or institutions."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13241> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An official list or schedule setting forth the duties imposed by a government on imported or exported goods."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13255> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The price actually given in current market dealings; the actual price at which given stock or commodity is currently sold in the usual and ordinary course of trade and competition between sellers and buyers."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13261> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The collection and processing of financial information to assist with the handling, direction, or control of an organization."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13262> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The guiding procedure, philosophy or course of action for an enterprise or company organized for commercial purposes."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13269> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any contract in which there are public funds provided though private persons may perform the contract and the subject of the contract may ultimately benefit private persons."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13272> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A body of rules or orders prescribed by government or management for the safe and orderly movement of vehicles on land, sea or in the air."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13273> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A body of rules or orders prescribed by government, management or an international organization or treaty pertaining to the cultivation of land, raising crops, or feeding, breeding and raising livestock."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13275> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The service provided by an owner agreeing to grant the temporary possession of specific housing in return for the payment of rent from the tenant."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13278> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Business operation or action that confines or limits the free exchange of goods and services within a country or between countries, which may include discrimination, exclusive dealings, collusion agreements or price fixing."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1327> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any substance used in or resulting from a reaction involving changes to atoms or molecules."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13284> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Term includes all proceedings authorised or sanctioned by law, and brought or instituted in a court of legal tribunal, for the acquiring of a right or the enforcement of a remedy."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13285> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The right of citizens to access to the organs of the governments where justice is administered."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13286> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Term used in commercial law, including a corporation, government or governmental subdivision or agency, business trust, estate, trust, partnership or association, two or more persons having a joint or common interest, or any other legal or commercial entity."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13290> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any prescribed step or manner of proceeding that a law making body takes in proposing laws, resolutions or special acts before they can be enacted or passed."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13292> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An organization's complex system of mutually connected and dependent elements or parts, which make up a definite manner of arrangement."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13297> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A course of action adopted and pursued by government, business or some other organization, which plans or organizes for the maintenance, development and erection of houses, offices, bridges or other building structures."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13298> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Measures and practices adopted by governments relating to the management of communication media."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13300> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A course of action adopted and pursued by government or some other organization, which seeks to support research and the exploration of planets, asteroids and other elements in the region beyond earth's atmosphere or beyond the solar system."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13304> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A controversy, disagreement, quarrel or warfare between or among two or more nations or countries, often requiring involvement or monitoring by other members of the global community."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13305> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The activities to prevent, contain, moderate and/or terminate the hostilities between or within States, through the medium of an impartial third party intervention, organised and directed internationally. This intervention is conducted using military forces, police and civilians with the consent of the main belligerents, to complement the diplomatic conflict resolution process and, to restore and maintain peace."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13306> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Procedure or course of action taken to curb or reduce human-made or human-alteration of the physical, biological, chemical and radiological integrity of air, water and other media."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13307> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A position along a scale of increasingly advanced training marking the degree or grade of instruction either obtained by an individual, offered by a some entity or necessary for a particular job or task."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13308> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Informal learning or formal instruction with broad application to human existence beyond the domain of any particular subject or discipline, often equated with liberal arts in the university setting and contrasted to courses required for a specific major or program."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13309> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The material studied in or for an educational institution, comprising homework and work done in the classroom."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13313> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The agents, instruments, methods or resources used to impart or interchange thoughts, opinions or information."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13329> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Just claims, legal guarantees or moral principles accorded to each and every member of a group or state, including the freedom to do certain things and the freedom from certain intrusions imposed by the collective body."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13330> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The just claims and legal guarantees to access, participate in and profit from the production, distribution and use of property, intellectual property, income and wealth."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13336> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The standing of an individual with regard to a legally recognized conjugal relationship, either in the present or past."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1336> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Processes that alter the chemical structure of the constituents of the waste to produce either an innocuous or a less hazardous material. Chemical processes are attractive because they produce minimal air emissions, they can often be carried out on the site of the waste generator, and some processes can be designed and constructed as mobile units."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13552> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The sloping side of any hollow in the ground, especially when bordering a river."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13568> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A trail in the country along which one can walk, usually for pleasure or exercise."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13577> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A colorless gas that, at room temperature, reacts with oxygen to form nitrogen dioxide; may be used to form other compounds."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/135> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An image of the ground surface made on a light-sensitive material and taken at a high altitude from an aircraft, spacecraft or rocket."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1362> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Order of placental mammals comprising the bats having the front limbs modified as wings."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1368> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A class of persistent, broad-spectrum insecticides that linger in the environment and accumulate in the food chain. Among them are DDT, aldrin, dieldrin, heptachlor, chlordane, lindane, endrin, mirex, hexachloride, and toxaphene. In insects and other animals these compounds act primarily on the central nervous system. They also become concentrated in the fats of organisms and thus tend to produce fatty infiltration of the heart and fatty degeneration of the liver in vertebrates. In fishes they have the effect of preventing oxygen uptake, causing suffocation. They are also known to slow the rate of photosynthesis in plants. Their danger to the ecosystem resides in their rate stability and the fact that they are broad-spectrum poisons which are very mobile because of their propensity to stick to dust particles and evaporate with water into the atmosphere."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1373> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A very reactive and highly toxic green, gaseous element, belonging to the halogen family of substances. It is one of the most widespread elements, as it occurs naturally in sea-water, salt lakes and underground deposits, but usually occurs in a safe form as common salt (NaCl). Commercially it is used in large quantities by the chemical industry both as an element to produce chlorinated organic solvents, like polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs), and for the manufacture of polyvinyl chloride plastics, thermoplastic and hypochlorite bleaches. Chlorine was the basis for the organochlorine pesticides, like DDT and other agricultural chemicals that have killed wildlife. The reactivity of chlorine has proved disastrous for the ozone layer and has been the cause of the creation of the ozone hole, which was first detected in the Southern Hemisphere over Antarctica and then over the Northern Hemisphere."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/13781> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A valve or gate fitted to a sluice to control the rate of flow of water."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1384> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An interdiction on the manufacture or use of products that discharge chlorofluorocarbons and bromine-containing compounds into the atmosphere, thereby contributing to the depletion of the ozone layer."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1401> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A hard grey metallic element that takes a high polish, occurring principally in chromite: used in steel alloys and electroplating to increase hardness and corrosion-resistance."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1406> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The golden-brown and orange-yellow algae; a diverse group of microscopically small algae which inhabit fresh and salt water, many being planktonic. They contain carotenoid pigments and may be unicellular, colonial, filamentous or amoeboid."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1419> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "State of citizens of being aware of their civic obligations."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14208> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The entire course of action necessary to bring a law, resolution or special act to an authoritative, legally binding status."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1421> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Term used generically today to denote any urban form but applied particularly to large urban settlements. There are, however, no agreed definitions to separate a city from the large metropolis or the smaller town."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14245> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Product that has undergone a partial processing and is used as raw material in a successive productive step."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1426> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Place where a town's refuse is disposed of after it has been collected."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1436> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The organization and measures, usually under governmental or other authority depending on the country, aimed at preventing, abating or fighting major emergencies for the protection of the civilian population and property, particularly in wartime."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14418> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "System of heating all houses in a urban district from a central source (as from hot springs in Iceland or by cooling water from a power station)."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1446> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Legal action initiated by a single person or a few people on behalf of a group with similar claim or claims."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1449> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A loose, earthy, extremely fine-grained, natural sediment or soft rock composed primarily of clay-size or colloidal particles and characterized by high plasticity and by a considerable content of clay mineral and subordinate amounts of finely divided quartz, decomposed feldspar, carbonates, ferruginous matter, and other impurities; it forms a plastic, moldable mass when finely ground and mixed with water, retains its shape on drying, and becomes firm, rocklike and permanently hard on heating or firing."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1460> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Industrial process which causes little or no pollution."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14615> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The activity of rowing, sailing or using a boat over a particular region of water, for amusement or enjoyment."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14663> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A map for navigation that delineates a portion of the sea, indicating the outline of the coasts and the position of rocks, sandbanks and other parts of a sea."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1466> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Precautionary actions, procedures or installations undertaken to prevent or reduce harm from pollution to natural weather conditions or patterns, including the prevailing temperature, atmospheric composition and precipitation."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/146> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A process requiring the presence of oxygen."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1473> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Experiments conducted to estimate future climatic conditions employing modelling of the physical processes underlying climatic change and variability; also, assessments are required of uncertain future man-made inputs such as increasing atmospheric carbon dioxide and other green-house gases."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1476> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A belt of the earth's surface within which the climate is generally homogeneous in some respect; an elemental region of a simple climatic classification."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1482> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any objective evidence of disease or of a patient's condition founded on clinical observation."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14844> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The largest inland sea between Europe, Africa and Asia, linked to the Atlantic Ocean at its western end by the Strait of Gibraltar, including the Tyrrhenian, Adriatic, Aegean and Ionian seas, and major islands such as Sicily, Sardina, Corsica, Crete, Malta and Cyprus."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14856> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The basic, underlying framework and features of a communications system supporting the exchange of knowledge, including hardware, software and transmission media."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14858> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An organization established primarily to acquire, analyze, process, store, retrieve, and disseminate one or more types of data."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14859> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A business or organization that supplies connections to a part of the Internet, often through telephone lines."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14861> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A system of interrelated computer and telecommunications devices linking two or more computers separated by a great distance for the exchange of electronic data."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14863> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A graphical, interactive, hypertext information system that is cross-platform and can be run locally or over the global Internet. The Web consists of Web servers offering pages of information to Web browsers who view and interact with the pages. Pages can contain formatted text, background colors, graphics, as well as audio and video clips. Simple links in a Web page can cause the browser to jump to a different part of the same page or to a page on a Web server halfway around the world. Web pages can be used to send mail, read news, and download files. A Web address is called a URL."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14864> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The preset document that is displayed after starting a World Wide Web browser, or the main World Wide Web document in a series of related documents."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14866> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An assemblage of computer hardware and software that can be linked by computer modem dialing for the purpose of sharing or exchanging messages or other files."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14868> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Information or computer stored messages that are transmitted or exchanged from one computer terminal to another, through telecommunication."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1486> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The cessation, discontinuation or breaking-off of a business transaction, lease, contract or employment arrangement, usually before its anticipated or stipulated end."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14872> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A display of an object or collection of objects for general dissemination of information, aesthetic value or entertainment."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14873> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A printed periodical bulletin circulated to members of a group."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14875> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A performance or production transmitted in audiovisual signals with electromagnetic waves."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14876> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The methods and activities employed by an individual, organization, corporation, or government to promote a favourable relationship with the public."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14879> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Data pertaining to the history, physical description, comparison, and classification of books and other works."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1487> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The termination or shutdown, temporary or permanent, of a corporation, factory or some other business organization."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14880> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A coordinated assemblage of people, devices or other resources organized to provide directions leading people to sources known to provide knowledge or assistance on a specified topic or request."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14882> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A coordinated assemblage of people, devices or other resources enabling the exchange of numerical data that has been collected, classified or interpreted for analysis."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14884> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The duties of an establishment, or a public institution, charged with the care and organizing of a collection of printed and other materials, and the duty of interpreting such materials to meet the informational, cultural, educational, recreational or research needs of its clients."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14885> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The provision of aid by library staff trained to interpret library materials and library organizational structures to meet the informational, educational, cultural, recreational or research needs of the library's clients."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14887> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The service provided by a library in which the library's clients are temporarily allowed to use books and other printed materials outside the library."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14888> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The service provided by one library in which a second library's clients are temporarily allowed to use books and other printed materials belonging to the first library; and consequently the system providing rules and infrastructure for this service to a group of libraries."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14890> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The provision of special aid by library staff trained to query bibliographic or other information contained on an electronic storage medium, usually to meet the research needs of the library's clients."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14891> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The provision of special aid by library staff trained to query bibliographic or other information contained on the Internet, a large distributed electronic system, usually to meet the research needs of the library's clients."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14899> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A remote sensing term which has three separate applications: a) spatial resolution, which refers to the ability of a sensor to distinguish between objects that are spatially close to each other. It is a measure of the smallest angular or linear separation between two objects. b) Spectral resolution which refers to the ability of a sensor to distinguish between objects which are spectrally similar. It is a measure of both the discreteness of wavebands and the sensitivity of the sensor to distinguish between electromagnetic radiation intensity levels. c) Thermal resolution which refers to the ability of a sensor to distinguish between objects with a similar temperature."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14901> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Closely grouped bands of lines characteristic of molecular gases of chemical compounds (spectroscopy)."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14902> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A numeric string which uniquely identifies an image component of a geographical information system database."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14907> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A remote sensing term related to image enhancement that refers to the removal of a spatial component of electromagnetic radiation."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14910> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The process of linking map coordinates to control points with known earth-surface coordinates. Related term: coordinate systems."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14913> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Unsupervised classification is a kind of classification which takes place with minimum input from the operator; no training sample is available and subdivision of the feature space is achieved by identifying natural groupings of the measurement vectors."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14921> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "In the vector type of GIS internal data organization spatial data are conveniently divided into point, line and polygon types. Some vector GIS store information in the form of points, line segments and point pairs; others maintain close lists of points defining polygon regions."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14930> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The line demarcating recognized limits of established political units."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14932> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A limit or border of a geographic area under the jurisdiction of some governmental or managerial entity."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14935> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A reference system used to measure horizontal and vertical distances on a planimetric map. A coordinate system is usually defined by a map projection, a spheroid of reference, a datum, one or more standard parallels, a central meridian, and possible shifts in the x- and y-directions to locate x, y positions of point, line, and area features. A common coordinate system is used to spatially register geographic data for the same area."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14937> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Distance in degrees east or west of the prime meridian at 0° measured by the angle between the plane of the prime meridian and that of the meridian through the point in question, or by the corresponding time difference."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14939> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A laboratory where GIS data drawn from different sources are stored, handled, analyzed and updated."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14940> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Service providing an active connection with a communications network."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14965> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "All measures by which production and consumption processes are caused to generate less (or no waste), or to generate only those wastes that can be treated without causing problems."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14970> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The power of a government agency or its administrators to administer and implement laws and government policies applicable to a specific political subdivision or geographical area within the state."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14972> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The establishing of boulevards, turnpikes, highways and other routes on land."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/14983> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Research involving studies of all aspects of environmental conditions beyond the atmosphere of the earth."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15041> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "all living biomass above the soil including stem, stump, branches, bark, seeds and foliage"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15045> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The process of adjustment to actual or expected climate and its effects. In human systems, adaptation seeks to moderate or avoid harm or exploit beneficial opportunities. In some natural systems, human intervention may facilitate adjustment to expected climate and its effects."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15046> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The property of a system to adjust its characteristics or behaviour, in order to expand its coping range under existing climate variability, or future climate conditions. 
ACC definition: The ability of systems, institutions, humans, and other organisms to
adjust to potential damage, to take advantage of opportunities, or to
respond to consequences."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15048> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "any substance added to a fertiliser, soil improver or growing medium to improve the agronomic efficacy of the final product, or modify the environmental fate of the nutrients released by the fertilisers"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15051> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Ratio of the radiation (radiant or luminous energy) reflected by a surface to that incident on it."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15053> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The quality of outdoor air in our surrounding environment. It is typically measured near ground level, away from direct sources of pollution."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15054> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A naturally occurring biochemical process in which organic\nmaterial is broken down by bacteria in an oxygen-free environment."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15057> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "combination of structural and nonstructural practices\nserving a feedlot that provides for the collection, treatment, storage or land applications of animal waste"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15058> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Emissions of greenhouse gases, greenhouse gas precursors, and
aerosols caused by human activities. These activities include the burning
of fossil fuels, deforestation, land use changes, livestock production,
fertilization, waste management, and industrial processes."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1505> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Process of conversion of coal to a gaseous product which is used as fuel in electric power stations."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15061> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "total of built-up areas plus artificial non-built-up areas"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15062> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "suspensions of solids and/or liquid particles in the air that we breathe, as dust, smoke and haze, measured by the mass concentration of aerosol particles or by an optical measure"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15066> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "rules laid down by the European Union (EU) for the monitoring, assessment and management of the quality of bathing water, and for the provision of information on that quality to reduce and prevent the pollution of bathing water and to inform European citizens of the degree of pollution"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1506> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The process of preparing a liquid mixture of hydrocarbons by destructive distillation of coal."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15072> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The capacity of ecosystems to regenerate what people demand from those surfaces. The biocapacity of a particular surface represents its ability to renew what people demand. Biocapacity is therefore the ecosystems' capacity to produce biological materials used by people and to absorb waste material generated by humans, under current management schemes and extraction technologies. Biocapacity can change from year to year due to climate, management, and also what portions are considered useful inputs to the human economy."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15074> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Long term or permanent qualitative or quantitative reduction in components of biodiversity and their potential to provide goods and services, to be measured at global, regional and national levels"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15075> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "conserving the resilience and vitality of natural ecosystems both for their intrinsic value and also for the benefits that they provide to human society as healthy ecosystems constitute our best defence against the worst extremes of weather associated with climate change"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15076> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "New and quickly developing branch of industry in most of European countries to find different efficient solution of energy conversion from different biomass recourses"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15306> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "increase in per capita real income or real GNP which can be sustained in the long term (i.e. while maintaining macroeconomic stability and keeping pace with demographic changes)"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15310> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "treatment of animal by-products under the following conditions"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15311> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "new definition: multi-dimensional and fundamental processes of change in socio-technical systems and their interactions with ecosystems"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15318> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "process of data collection, profile and consultations designed to provide an informational and consensual basis for preparing an urban environmental management strategy"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15319> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "set of transportation and circulation policies and measures which seek to provide ample and democratic access to the urban space, through prioritization of mass transit means of transportation"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15320> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "EU directive aiming to protect the environment from the adverse effects of discharges of waste water from urban areas and industry"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15322> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "analysis of the expected impacts, risks and the adaptive capacity of a region or sector to the effects of climate change"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15324> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "processes in which the gas emissions from waste disposal are converted into harmless substances by means of chemical reactions"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15326> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "system developed for the collection, transport, recovery and disposal of waste, including the supervision of such operations and the after-care of disposal sites"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15329> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "the output over time of a given major sector per volume of (net) water withdrawn"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1532> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A metallic element used chiefly in alloys."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15330> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Directive 2000/60/EC establishing a framework for Community action in the field of water policy"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15331> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "environmental sustainability in the management of water resources, via integrated ecosystem approaches, access to good quality water in sufficient quantity and contribution to the internationally agreed targets and goals relevant to water and socio-economic development"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15334> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "use of water by agriculture, industry, energy production and households, including in-stream uses such as fishing, recreation, transportation and waste disposal."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15335> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "relatively untouched natural areas that have not been significantly modified by human activity, including core areas for nature on land or at sea where nature and wildlife thrive"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15336> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The global capacity of ecosystems to regenerate what people demand from those surfarces"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15338> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Forward-looking approach that aims to help decision-makers explore and anticipate in a participatory way what might happen, as well as prepare for a range of possible future scenarios, influence them and shape the futures. Foresight typically involves systematic, participatory, future-intelligence-gathering and medium-to-long-term vision-building processes to uncover a range of possible alternative future visions. Key foresight methods include horizon scanning and scenario building."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1533> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The most primitive of the living winged insects. It is thought they have been unchanged for more than 300 million years, and are among the oldest fossil insects. Cockroaches are usually found in tropical climates, but a few species, out of the total 3.500 known species, have become pests. They are common household pests in many countries, imported by ship and carried home in grocery bags. Cockroaches eat plant and animal products, including food, paper, clothing and soiled hospital waste, fouling everything they touch with their droppings and unpleasant odour, to which many people are allergic. They are a major health hazard and carry harmful bacteria, protozoan parasites and faunal pathogens, including those that cause typhoid, leprosy and salmonella. Conventional insecticides make little or no impact on the cockroaches population."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15340> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Written story lines (based on a literature review and on creative and logical thinking of the authors) used as parts of a horizon scan or a scenario study.  A story line consists of a coherent description of several possible or desirable future developments and/or events which can lead to a possible or desirable future."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15342> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "waste from accommodation used purely for living purposes and which is disposed of via the normal mixed domestic refuse collection"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15343> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "air pollution that contains a range of health-damaging pollutants, such as small particles and carbon monoxide (CO), and levels of particulate pollutants that can many times be higher than accepted guideline values for indoor spaces"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15349> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "change to the global average temperature that can lead to climate change"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15350> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "abatement end-of-pipe technology, which is fitted to large combustion plants such as power plants"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15351> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "forløp for bevegelse av forurensning gjennom mediet, fram til den unnslipper systemet, nemlig gjennom bevegelse i en væskemasse (luft, havstrømmer) eller transport av forurensning eller plankton gjennom slik bevegelse"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15351> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "mechanism by which contaminants are moving through the media until they escape the system, namely via the movement of a mass of fluid (air, ocean current) or the transport of pollutants or plankton by such movement"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15352> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "et resultat av eller produsert av menneskelig aktivitet"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15352> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "resulting from or produced by human activities"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15353> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "animal and plant life of a particular region, habitat or geological period"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15353> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "dyre- og planteliv innenfor et bestemt område, habitat eller geologisk periode"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15354> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "vannsystem som forsyner stedegne arter med vann opprettholder naturlige økologiske prosesser, forhindrer flom, opprettholder luft- og vannressurser og bidrar til god helse og livskvalitet for lokalsamfunn"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15354> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "water network that supports native species, maintains natural ecological processes, prevents flooding, sustains air and water resources and contributes to the health and quality of life of local communities"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15356> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "materielle eiendeler som direkte eller indirekte eksponeres for høye nivåer av klimagassutslipp, for eksempel eiendeler i fossilindustrien, eller som er svært avhengige av fossilt brensel"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15356> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "physical financial asset with direct or indirect exposure to high levels of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, such as assets in the fossil fuel industry, or that are heavily reliant on fossil fuels"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15360> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "investeringsindeks som i tillegg til finansielle investeringsmål omfatter spesifikke mål knyttet til reduksjon i utslipp av klimagasser og overgang til lavkarbonøkonomi gjennom utvelgelse og vekting av indeksens underliggende bestanddeler"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15360> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "investment benchmark that incorporates, next to financial investment objectives, specific objectives related to greenhouse gas emission reductions and the transition to a low-carbon economy through the selection and weighting of underlying benchmark constituents"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15361> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "human activities which  result in no net effect on the climate system by balancing residual emissions with emission (carbon dioxide) removal as well as accounting for regional or local biogeophysical effects of human activities that affect surface albedo or local climate"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15361> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "menneskelig aktivitet som ikke påvirker klimasystemet, ved å balansere restutslipp og utslippsfjerning (karbondioksid) i tillegg til å ta høyde for regionale og lokale biogeofysiske virkninger av menneskelig aktivitet som påvirker overflatens refleksjonsevne eller det lokale klimaet"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15362> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "avgift på importvarer for å motvirke karbonlekkasjen som går ut over bedrifter i land med strengere regler"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15362> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "levy on imported goods to counter carbon leakage, in order to avoid industries in countries with stricter rules being penalised"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15363> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "combination of the perceived variables visual attractiveness, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use and perceived risk of a product or service"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15363> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "en kombinasjon av oppfatningen av variabler, for eksempel av utseende, nytteverdi, anvendelighet og risiko ved et produkt eller en tjeneste"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15367> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "alle typer noterte og unoterte obligasjoner og kapitalmarkedsinstrumenter som utstedes av europeiske eller internasjonale utstedere i henhold til EUs standard for grønne obligasjoner"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15367> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "any type of listed or unlisted bond or capital market debt instrument issued by a European or international issuer that is aligned with the EU GBS"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1536> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The quantity of oxygen used in biological and non-biological oxidation of materials in water; a measure of water quality."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15372> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "activity producing goods and services to measure, prevent, limit, minimise or correct environmental damage to water, air and soil, as well as problems related to waste, noise and eco-systems, including technologies, products and services that reduce environmental risk, minimise pollution and resources"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15372> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "arbeid som består i å produsere varer og tjenester for å måle, forebygge, begrense, minimere eller korrigere miljøskader på vann, luft og jord, så vel som problemer knyttet til avfall, støy og økosystemer, herunder teknologier, produkter og tjenester som reduserer miljørisiko, reduserer forurensning og bevarer ressurser"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15373> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "incorporation of climate risks into banks' risk management policies by supporting financial institutions that contribute to funding sustainable projects"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15373> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "integrering av klimarisiko i bankenes retningslinjer for risikostyring ved å støtte finansinstitusjoner som bidrar til å finansiere bærekraftige prosjekter"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15374> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "bærekraftige produkter som er utformet for å redusere miljøvirkningene mest mulig gjennom hele produktets livssyklus, også når det ikke lenger kan brukes, for å redusere avfallsmengden og øke ressurseffektiviteten mest mulig"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15374> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "sustainable product designed to minimise its environmental impact during the whole life-cycle, and even after it is of no use, to reduce waste and maximise resource efficiency"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15375> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "benefit-making resource with economic value that is negatively related to the risk of global warming and carbon emissions"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15375> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "verdiskapende ressurs hvis økonomiske verdi er negativt korrelert med risikoen for global oppvarming og karbonutslipp"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15378> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "effektiv, bærekraftig bruk av ressurser ved å minimere miljøpåvirkningen, skape mer med mindre gjennom hele livssyklusen, fra materialutvinning, ressursbruk og vedlikehold, til materialgjenvinning"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15378> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "efficient, sustainable use of resources by minimising the impact on the environment,  creating more with less throughout the entire lifecycle, from material extraction, resource use and maintenance to material recovery"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15379> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "cost-effective approach that uses nature to deliver a range of critical services (wetlands for flood mitigation, carbon sequestration, improved air quality) that provides environmental, social and economic benefits, helping to build resilience by bringing more natural features and processes into the cities, landscapes and seascapes through locally adapted, resource-efficient and systemic interventions"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15379> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "kostnadseffektiv tilnærming som bruker naturen for å levere en rekke kritiske tjenester (våtmark for flombegrensning, karbonlagring, bedret luftkvalitet) som gir miljømessige, sosiale og økonomiske fordeler, bidrar til å øke robustheten ved å tilføre byene, landskapene og kysten mer naturlige egenskaper og prosesser gjennom lokalt tilpassede, ressurseffektive og systemiske intervensjoner"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15380> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "globally balanced anthropogenic CO2 emissions through anthropogenic CO2 removals over a specified period"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15380> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "globalt balanserte menneskeskapte CO2-utslipp gjennom fjerning av menneskeskapt CO2 i en gitt periode"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15382> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "excessive consumption or use of goods and services (energy, land, water or materials) that cause harm or detrimental effects to humans and/or the environment, namely by exceeding the carrying capacity and life supporting systems of the planet and its ecosystems"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15382> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "overdrevent forbruk eller bruk av varer og tjenester (energi, areal, vann eller materialer) som skader eller er ugunstig for mennesker og/eller miljøet, det vil si ved å overskride planetens og økosystemenes bæreevne og livsunderstøttende systemer"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15388> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "integrasjon av miljømessige, sosiale og styringsmessige kriterier i driften og forretningsvirksomheten i tradisjonell bankvirksomhet"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15388> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "integration of environmental, social and governance criteria into traditional banking operational and business activities"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15389> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "process of taking due account of environmental and social considerations in investment decision-making, leading to increased investments in longer-term and sustainable activities"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15389> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "prosessen med å integrere miljømessige og sosiale hensyn i investeringsbeslutninger og derved bidra til økte investeringer i langsiktige og bærekraftige aktiviteter"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15391> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "change required when efforts to change one aspect of a system fail to fix the problem and the whole system needs to be transformed, namely the fundamental qualities of the system itself, through innovation, experimentation, constant learning and adaptation"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15391> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "endring som kreves når innsatsen for å endre én side ved et system ikke løser problemet og hele systemet må transformeres, dvs. de grunnleggende egenskapene ved selve systemet, gjennom innovasjon, eksperimentering og kontinuerlig læring og tilpasning"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15392> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "framework to facilitate sustainable investment by establishing an EU-wide classification system to provide firms and investors with a common framework for identifying to what degree economic activities can be considered to be 'environmentally sustainable'"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15392> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "ramme som skal legge til rette for bærekraftige investeringer ved å etablere et klassifiseringssystem i EU som gir selskaper og investorer en felles ramme for å fastslå i hvilken grad økonomiske aktiviteter kan anses som ”miljømessig bærekraftige”"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15393> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "systematic long-term risk mispricing and reduction of the diversity of investments between issuers of securities (mostly long-term), intermediaries (mostly short-term) and beneficiaries (mostly long-term) that leads to a short-term focus on risk metrics and incentives, amplifying the mispricing of actual risk and opportunities"@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/15393> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "systematisk langvarig feilprising av risiko og reduksjon av mangfoldet i investeringer blant utstedere av verdipapirer (hovedsakelig langsiktige), formidlere (hovedsakelig kortsiktige) og mottakere (hovedsakelig langsiktige) som fører til et kortsiktig fokus på risikomåling og insentiver, som forsterker feilprisingen av faktiske risikoer og muligheter"@no <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1548> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Animals that have a single body cavity (the coelenteron). The name was formerly given to a phylum comprising the Cnidaria and Ctenophora, but these are now regarded as phyla in their own right, and the name Coelenterata has fallen from use, although it is sometimes used as a synonym for Cnidaria."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1550> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Usually the generation of heat in the form of steam, and the generation of power in the form of electricity. Combined heat and power plants are able to convert a much higher proportion of the energy in fuel into final output. The steam produced may be used through heat exchangers in a district heating scheme, while the electricity provides lighting and power."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1553> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Joint incineration of hazardous waste, in any form, with refuse and/or sludge."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1559> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The interacting system of a biological community and its non-living environmental surroundings located in climatic regions where the air temperature is below 10° Celsius for eight to eleven months of the year."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1567> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An intimate mixture of two substances, one of which, called the dispersed phase, is uniformly distributed in a finely divided state through the second substance, called the dispersion medium."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1569> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The successful invasion of a new habitat by a species."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1571> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An attribute of things that results from the light they reflect, transmit, or emit in so far as this light causes a visual sensation that depends on its wavelengths."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1575> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "This type of plant is flexible in response and can be built in the 100-600 MW capacity range. It produces electrical power from both a gas turbine (ca. 1300°C gas inlet temperature), fuelled by natural gas or oil plus a steam turbine supplied with the steam generated by the 500°C exhaust gases from the gas turbine. The thermal efficiency of these stations is ca. 50 per cent compared with a maximum of 40 per cent from steam turbine coal fired power stations. This type of plant can be built in two years compared with six years for a coal-fired station and 10-15 years for nuclear."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1588> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Holding or displaying for sale, offering for sale, selling, delivering or placing on the market in any other form."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1590> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The whole body of substantive jurisprudence applicable to the rights, intercourse and relations of persons engaged in commerce, trade or mercantile pursuits."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1594> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The operations and movements related to the transportation and exchange of goods."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1605> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The concept, science, technique and process of transmitting, receiving or otherwise exchanging information and data."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1616> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The law of European Community (as opposed to the national laws of the member states.) It consists of the treaties establishing the EC (together with subsequent amending treaties) community legislation, and decisions of the court of justice of the European Communities. Any provision of the treaties or of community legislation that is directly applicable or directly effective in a member state forms part of the law of that state and prevails over its national law in the event of any inconsistency between the two."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1618> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Involvement in public or private actions, as members or as a member of a particular ethnic, political or social group, with the purpose of exerting influence."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1636> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any administrative or legislative action, procedure or enactment designed to redress disruptions of ecological integrity or damage to the supply of natural resources."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/163> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Considerations, values, and judgements pertaining to the quality of the human perceptual experience (including sight, sound, smell, touch, taste, and movement) evoked by phenomena or components of the environment."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1645> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Formation of a complex compound. Also known as complexing or complexation."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1652> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The natural biological decomposition of organic material in the presence of air to form a humus-like material. Controlled methods of composting include mechanical mixing and aerating, ventilating the materials by dropping them through a vertical series of aerated chambers, or placing the compost in piles out in the open air and mixing it or turning it periodically."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1659> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Reduction in the volume of a substance due to pressure."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1660> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A mechanical device a) to provide the desired pressure for chemical and physical reactions, b) to control boiling points of fluids, as in gas separation, refrigeration, and evaporation, c) to evacuate enclosed volumes, d) to transport gases or vapors, e) to store compressible fluids as gases or liquids under pressure and assist in recovering them from storage or tank cars, and f) to convert mechanical energy to fluid energy for operating instruments, air agitation, fluidization, solid transport, blowcases, air tools, and motors."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1674> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The process of increasing the quantity of a component in a solution. The opposite of dilution."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1681> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Transformation from a gas to a liquid."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1690> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Clash between public interest and the private pecuniary interest of the individual concerned. A situation in which regard for one duty tends to lead to disregard of another."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1691> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "A formal meeting, often consisting of representatives of various organizations, that is assembled to promote, discuss or make arrangements regarding a particular subject or some matter of common interest."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1692> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "An order of conebearing plants which includes nearly all the present day Gymnospermae. Most are tall evergreen trees with needle-like (e.g., pines), linear (e.g. firs) or scale-like (e.g., cedars) leaves. They are characteristic of temperate zones and the main forest trees of colder regions. They provide timber, resins, tars, turpentine and pulp for paper."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/170> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "The second largest of the continents, on the Mediterranean in the north, the Atlantic in the west, and the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden, and Indian Ocean in the east. The Sahara desert divides the continent unequally into North Africa and Africa south of Sahara. The largest lake is Lake Victoria and the chief rivers are the Nile, Niger, Congo, and Zambezi. The hottest continent, Africa has vast mineral resources, many of which are still undeveloped."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1724> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Noise resulting from construction activities such as site preparation, site clearance, demolition of existing buildings, piling, concreting, erection of structures, etc."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1730> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Construction with waste product used as raw material."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .

<http://www.eionet.europa.eu/gemet/concept/1732> <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#definition> "Any meeting or inquiry of concerned persons or advisors for the purpose of deliberation, discussion or decision on some matter or action."@en <urn:graph-verity:gemet:4.2.3> .
